description:
Resolve registered owners for parcels returned by `sourcing_search`.

    Uses the bulk HM Land Registry corporate and overseas ownership registers,
    so it names companies, public bodies and overseas entities. Individually
    owned titles are not in the bulk data and come back unresolved — that is a
    gap in the free register, not a failed lookup, and naming an individual
    requires a paid per-title purchase which this tool does not make.

    UK only. Costs 25 credits (25p).
name: sourcing_owners
title: Owners of sourced parcels
